WHY THE SNAPSHOTS ARE COMMITTED. easylist.to serves only the current
list and expires it in four days, so a digest pin with no bytes behind
it would stop being reproducible the day upstream rolls. The tree is
the durable pin; the digests above say these committed bytes are the
ones taken from upstream, and the builder refuses to package anything
WHY ONE PACK AND NOT TWO ASSETS. The two lists are enabled together or
not at all - EasyPrivacy without EasyList is not a posture the product
offers - and one artifact is one digest to verify and one download to
resume. Regional lists, which ARE independently enabled by locale, get
THE REVISION anchors on the EasyList version because the two lists roll
together at upstream and EasyList is the larger half; a refresh of
either produces a new snapshot pair, a new revision, and a new row.
